user.title: Configure outdoor inputs
user.description: Choose the entities that describe current outdoor conditions. Exactly one humidity source is required.

data_description.humidity_entity: Select this or dew point, but not both.
data_description.dew_point_entity: Select this or relative humidity, but not both.
data_description.wind_speed_entity: Used as observed wind for UTCI; walking air movement is added only for the Gagge model.

solar.name: Solar inputs
solar.description: Optional. Configure DNI, or configure both GHI and diffuse irradiance. Sun sensors are omitted when no irradiance source is selected.

data_description.solar_altitude_entity: For a Sun entity, Sweat reads its elevation attribute. A numeric entity may instead report degrees as its state.

forecast.name: 48-hour forecast
forecast.description: Optional. Select all six input_text entities or leave all six empty. Series use canonical units: °C, °C, m/s, and W/m².

advanced.name: Advanced assumptions
advanced.description: Physiological and solar-model assumptions. These can be changed later in integration options.

data_description.walking_speed: Added to observed wind only for the Gagge wettedness model.
data_description.sky_view_factor: Street-canyon estimate. In SolarCal it scales diffuse and ground-reflected radiation, not direct beam.
data_description.f_bes: Fraction of the possible body surface exposed to direct sun.
data_description.sol_transmittance: Use 1 outdoors with no window or other solar barrier.
data_description.sharp: Orientation assumption: 0° is front, 90° is side-on, and 180° is back.

reconfigure.title: Change source entities
reconfigure.description: Change the current-condition or forecast source entities.

error.choose_one_humidity_source: Select exactly one of relative humidity or dew point.
error.unsupported_solar_combination: Configure DNI, or configure both GHI and diffuse irradiance.
error.solar_altitude_required: Solar altitude is required when irradiance is configured.
error.forecast_all_or_none: Select all six forecast entities or leave all six empty.
error.invalid_temperature_source: The selected temperature or dew-point entity must have a numeric state and a supported temperature unit.
error.invalid_humidity_source: The selected humidity entity must be a value from 0 to 100 with a percent unit.
error.invalid_wind_source: The selected wind entity must have a nonnegative numeric state and a supported wind-speed unit.
error.invalid_irradiance_source: Selected irradiance entities must be nonnegative numbers in W/m².
error.invalid_altitude_source: The solar-altitude source must provide a numeric state or elevation attribute no greater than 90°.
error.invalid_forecast_source: Forecast helpers must share one UTC-hour-aligned epoch and contain 48 physically valid hourly integers.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Sweat configuration is supported.
